Sandbox_DynamicTrading.RarityBonus_toolt: Increases or decreases the likelihood of rare items appearing. Positive values make rare loot more common.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.RestockInterval_t: How many days must pass before a trader refreshes their inventory.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ScanBaseChance_to: The base probability of finding a signal when scanning with a standard Walkie Talkie.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ScanCooldown_tool: Real-time minutes a player must wait between scanning attempts.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.HamRadioBonus_too: Multiplier applied to scan chance when using a stationary HAM Radio (vs Handheld).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.ScanPenaltyPerTra: Reduces scan chance based on how many traders have already been found today. Higher = Harder to find the last few traders.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.SeasonImpact_tool: How strongly seasons affect prices (e.g. Winter making food expensive).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.CategoryInflation: How fast prices rise when players buy out a specific category (Supply & Demand).
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TraderStayHoursMi: Minimum in-game hours a trader stays connected before leaving.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.TraderStayHoursMa: Maximum in-game hours a trader stays connected before leaving.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.PublicNetwork_too: ENABLED: All traders are shared. Everyone sees all discovered traders instantly (Classic Mode).\nDISABLED: Players must individually discover traders via radio scanning. Better radios = more discoveries before traders leave.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletMinCashPerc: The minimum percentage of (Global Wealth / Trader Capacity) that a trader receives as their budget.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletMaxCashPerc: The maximum percentage of (Global Wealth / Trader Capacity) that a trader receives as their budget.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletEmptyChance: Percentage chance a wallet contains nothing but junk.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.WalletJackpotChan: Chance to hit the 'Tax Return' tier, granting max cash + bonus.
Sandbox_DynamicTrading.SellDeflationChan: The chance (1 in X) that selling an item causes its global market value to decrease.
